listing.summary: The project reports health screens, logos and gameplay at 59.94 VPS. A recurring 3D graphics defect remains. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.instruction: Use your own USA GGTE01 ISO or complete extracted GAME directory.

steps.instruction: Follow the Makefile instructions to extract your own files, translate the game code and compile the module locally.
